\#^    if (\*(u8 \*\*) (rec->obj + 0x1D4) == NULL) {#s/== NULL/!= NULL/

\#^    dspeed = rec->u44 - speed;#s/u44/u40/

\#^        if (1.0f < rec->u7C) {#s/1.0f/0.5f/

\#^        if (1.0f < rec->u88) {#s/</>/

\#^        pt = &pts\[(s8) e\[0x2E\]\];#s/0x2E/0x2D/
\#^        pt->age = 0;#s/0;/1;/
